017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server;
018
019import static java.lang.annotation.RetentionPolicy.*;
020
021import java.lang.annotation.*;
022
023import org.apache.juneau.marshall.httppart.*;
024import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.converter.*;
025import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.guard.*;
026import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.logger.*;
027
028/**
029 * Host-side setting seed for the {@link Rest#childrenDefs() @Rest(childrenDefs=...)} attribute.
030 *
031 * <p>
032 * Declares a routed child class <b>and</b> lets the <i>host</i> seed a curated set of {@code @Rest}-level
033 * settings onto that child's otherwise-isolated {@link RestContext} &mdash; the child-resource analog of
034 * {@link Rest#mixinDefs() @Rest(mixinDefs=...)}. This is the host-side complement to
035 * {@link Rest#children() @Rest(children=...)} (which takes bare classes and offers no seed hook).
036 *
037 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
038 * <p class='bjava'>
039 *    <ja>@Rest</ja>(
040 *       childrenDefs=<ja>@Child</ja>(type=FooChild.<jk>class</jk>, callLogger=SeedLogger.<jk>class</jk>)
041 *    )
042 *    <jk>public class</jk> MyResource { ... }
043 * </p>
044 *
045 * <h5 class='section'>Seed semantics</h5>
046 * <p>
047 * Unlike {@link Mixin @Mixin} overrides (which win over an <i>inherited</i> chain), children are
048 * <b>isolated</b> from the host's resolution chain by design, so a {@code @Child} seed doesn't override
049 * anything &mdash; it seeds settings onto an otherwise-isolated child context:
050 * <ul>
051 *    <li><b>Additive-security</b> ({@code guards}, {@code converters}, {@code roleGuard}, {@code rolesDeclared})
052 *       &mdash; the host contributes, the child can't remove or weaken it (list-shaped members prepend; the two
053 *       role-based members AND-stack alongside the child's own value).
054 *    <li><b>Child-wins scalars</b> ({@code callLogger}, {@code partSerializer}, {@code partParser}, {@code debug},
055 *       {@code defaultCharset}, {@code maxInput}) &mdash; the seed is a default/fallback; the child's own explicit
056 *       {@code @Rest} declaration wins when present.
057 * </ul>
058 *
059 * <p>
060 * A child's own {@code @Rest(noInherit="&lt;property&gt;")} cuts the corresponding {@code @Child} seed too,
061 * for both buckets above &mdash; the child always stays in full control of its own configuration.
062 *
063 * <p>
064 * There is no {@code noInherit()} member on {@code @Child} itself (nothing to cut in an isolated context), and
065 * no {@code path()}/{@code paths()} re-mount member (the child's own {@code @Rest(path)} stays authoritative).
066 *
067 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
068 *    <li class='ja'>{@link Rest#childrenDefs()}
069 *    <li class='ja'>{@link Rest#children()}
070 * </ul>
071 *
072 * @since 10.0.0
073 */
074@Target({})
075@Retention(RUNTIME)
076public @interface Child {
077
078   /**
079    * The child class to route.
080    *
081    * <p>
082    * Required. Equivalent to a bare entry in {@link Rest#children()}, but with the seed slots below.
083    *
084    * @return The child class.
085    */
086   Class<?> type();
087
088   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
089   // Additive-security seed slots — host contributes, child can't remove or weaken.
090   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
091
092   /**
093    * Host-seeded {@link Rest#guards() guards} for this child's endpoints (prepended before the child's own).
094    *
095    * @return The annotation value.
096    */
097   Class<? extends RestGuard>[] guards() default {};
098
099   /**
100    * Host-seeded {@link Rest#converters() converters} for this child's endpoints (prepended before the child's own).
101    *
102    * @return The annotation value.
103    */
104   Class<? extends RestConverter>[] converters() default {};
105
106   /**
107    * Host-seeded {@link Rest#roleGuard() roleGuard} for this child's endpoints (AND-stacks with the child's own).
108    *
109    * @return The annotation value.
110    */
111   String roleGuard() default "";
112
113   /**
114    * Host-seeded {@link Rest#rolesDeclared() rolesDeclared} for this child's endpoints (AND-stacks with the child's own).
115    *
116    * @return The annotation value.
117    */
118   String rolesDeclared() default "";
119
120   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
121   // Child-wins scalar seed slots — seed is a default/fallback; the child's own explicit value wins.
122   //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
123
124   /**
125    * Host-seeded {@link Rest#callLogger() callLogger} default for this child's endpoints.
126    *
127    * @return The annotation value.
128    */
129   Class<? extends CallLogger> callLogger() default CallLogger.Void.class;
130
131   /**
132    * Host-seeded {@link Rest#partSerializer() partSerializer} default for this child's endpoints.
133    *
134    * @return The annotation value.
135    */
136   Class<? extends HttpPartSerializer> partSerializer() default HttpPartSerializer.Void.class;
137
138   /**
139    * Host-seeded {@link Rest#partParser() partParser} default for this child's endpoints.
140    *
141    * @return The annotation value.
142    */
143   Class<? extends HttpPartParser> partParser() default HttpPartParser.Void.class;
144
145   /**
146    * Host-seeded {@link Rest#debug() debug} default for this child's endpoints (each sub-field independently seeded).
147    *
148    * @return The annotation value.
149    */
150   Debug debug() default @Debug;
151
152   /**
153    * Host-seeded {@link Rest#defaultCharset() defaultCharset} default for this child's endpoints.
154    *
155    * @return The annotation value.
156    */
157   String defaultCharset() default "";
158
159   /**
160    * Host-seeded {@link Rest#maxInput() maxInput} default for this child's endpoints.
161    *
162    * @return The annotation value.
163    */
164   String maxInput() default "";
165}
